instruction: How do I view git commit logs in a single line per commit?
output: Run `git log --oneline` to display a compact git commit history.

instruction: How do I stage all local changes for the next commit?
output: Run `git add .` to stage all modified and untracked files in the repository.

instruction: How do I create and switch to a new branch named 'dev'?
output: Run `git checkout -b dev` or `git switch -c dev` to create and switch to the branch.

instruction: How do I safely discard unstaged working directory changes?
output: Run `git restore <filename>` to discard unstaged modifications in your working tree.

instruction: How do I check current modified files in Git?
output: Run `git status` to view working directory and staging area status.

instruction: How do I push a new local branch to remote repository?
output: Run `git push -u origin <branch_name>` to set the upstream remote tracking branch.

instruction: How do I temporarily save uncommitted changes without committing?
output: Run `git stash` to temporarily save uncommitted modifications to the stash stack.

instruction: How do I restore the latest stashed modifications in Git?
output: Run `git stash pop` to apply and remove the most recent stash entry.

instruction: How do I check git commit history for a single file?
output: Run `git log -p filename` to view commit history and diffs for that file.

instruction: How do I change the message of the most recent commit?
output: Run `git commit --amend -m 'new message'` to modify the latest commit message.

instruction: How do I list all remote branches in Git?
output: Run `git branch -r` to display all remote tracking branches.

instruction: How do I delete a local branch named 'feature' safely?
output: Run `git branch -d feature` to safely delete the local branch.

instruction: How do I show differences between working directory and staging area?
output: Run `git diff` to view unstaged modifications in your repository.

instruction: How do I merge branch 'dev' into the current branch?
output: Run `git merge dev` to integrate changes from the dev branch into your current branch.

instruction: How do I unstage a file named 'app.py'?
output: Run `git restore --staged app.py` to remove the file from the staging area.

instruction: How do I download remote updates without merging them?
output: Run `git fetch` to download objects and refs from the remote repository.

instruction: How do I pull latest changes from remote and rebase?
output: Run `git pull --rebase` to fetch remote commits and rebase local commits on top.

instruction: How do I view commit history as an ASCII graph?
output: Run `git log --graph --oneline` to display commit branching history graphically.

instruction: How do I tag the current commit as 'v1.0.0'?
output: Run `git tag v1.0.0` to create a lightweight tag on the current HEAD commit.

instruction: How do I revert a specific commit safely by hash?
output: Run `git revert <commit_hash>` to create a new commit that undoes specified changes.

instruction: How do I clone a git repository recursively with submodules?
output: Run `git clone --recursive <url>` to clone the repository along with all submodules.

instruction: How do I inspect who last modified each line of a file?
output: Run `git blame <filename>` to view author and revision information for each line.

instruction: How do I apply a specific commit from another branch?
output: Run `git cherry-pick <commit_hash>` to apply the changes from that commit.

instruction: How do I check which branch contains a specific commit?
output: Run `git branch --contains <commit_hash>` to list branches including that commit.

instruction: How do I list saved stash entries in Git?
output: Run `git stash list` to inspect all saved stash stack entries.

instruction: How do I rename the current Git branch to 'main'?
output: Run `git branch -M main` to rename your current active branch to main.

instruction: How do I perform a dry-run check of untracked files before cleaning?
output: Run `git clean -nd` to preview untracked files that would be removed.

instruction: How do I check configured remote URLs in Git?
output: Run `git remote -v` to list all configured remote repository names and URLs.

instruction: How do I ignore file mode permission changes in Git?
output: Run `git config core.fileMode false` to stop tracking file executable bit changes.

instruction: How do I create a patch file from the latest commit?
output: Run `git format-patch -1 HEAD` to generate a patch file from the last commit.

instruction: How do I soft-reset the HEAD to the previous commit while keeping changes staged?
output: Run `git reset --soft HEAD~1` to move HEAD back while preserving changes.

instruction: How do I view the commit log for the last 5 commits?
output: Run `git log -n 5 --oneline` to view the last 5 commits in short format.

instruction: How do I compare commits between main and dev branches?
output: Run `git diff main..dev` to inspect differences between main and dev branches.

instruction: How do I show the contents of a specific commit?
output: Run `git show <commit_hash>` to display details and diff of a commit.

instruction: How do I check out a specific tag in Git?
output: Run `git checkout v1.0.0` to inspect the code at tag v1.0.0.

instruction: How do I list all local and remote branches in Git?
output: Run `git branch -a` to display both local and remote tracking branches.

instruction: How do I abort an in-progress merge conflict?
output: Run `git merge --abort` to cancel the merge and restore pre-merge state.

instruction: How do I abort an in-progress rebase?
output: Run `git rebase --abort` to stop the rebase and return to original branch state.

instruction: How do I set your Git user name globally?
output: Run `git config --global user.name 'Your Name'` to configure global commit author.

instruction: How do I set your Git user email globally?
output: Run `git config --global user.email 'email@example.com'` to configure commit email.

instruction: How do I search recursively for text 'ERROR' in log files?
output: Run `grep -rn 'ERROR' /var/log/` to search recursively with line numbers.

instruction: How do I find all Python files in current directory recursively?
output: Run `find . -name '*.py'` to locate all Python source files in subdirectories.

instruction: How do I make a shell script executable in Linux?
output: Run `chmod +x script.sh` to grant execution permissions to the script file.

instruction: How do I view real-time system process activity in Linux?
output: Run `top` or `htop` to display active system processes and resource usage.

instruction: How do I check available memory in human-readable units?
output: Run `free -h` to display total, used, and available RAM and swap space.

instruction: How do I check disk space usage of mounted filesystems?
output: Run `df -h` to view disk capacity and usage for all mounted filesystems.

instruction: How do I measure directory size in human-readable format?
output: Run `du -sh /path/to/dir` to calculate total size of a directory.

instruction: How do I continuously follow new lines added to a log file?
output: Run `tail -f app.log` to stream new log output in real time.

instruction: How do I send a graceful termination signal to process ID 1234?
output: Run `kill -15 1234` to send a standard SIGTERM signal to process ID 1234.

instruction: How do I print the active absolute working directory path?
output: Run `pwd` to print the full path of your current working directory.

instruction: How do I list all files including hidden files with details?
output: Run `ls -la` to list all files, permissions, owners, and hidden dotfiles.

instruction: How do I compress a folder named 'src' into a tar.gz archive?
output: Run `tar -czvf src.tar.gz src/` to create a compressed gzipped tar archive.

instruction: How do I extract a tar.gz archive named 'data.tar.gz'?
output: Run `tar -xzvf data.tar.gz` to extract all contents from the tar archive.

instruction: How do I check HTTP response headers for a URL using curl?
output: Run `curl -I https://example.com` to fetch and display HTTP response headers.

instruction: How do I check listening network ports on Linux?
output: Run `ss -tulpn` to list all active listening TCP and UDP sockets.

instruction: How do I check environment variables set in current shell?
output: Run `env` or `printenv` to print all active shell environment variables.

instruction: How do I create a symbolic link named 'link' to 'target'?
output: Run `ln -s target link` to create a symbolic link pointing to the target file.

instruction: How do I check Linux kernel version and architecture?
output: Run `uname -a` to print system architecture, hostname, and kernel version.

instruction: How do I measure command execution runtime in Bash?
output: Prefix your command with `time`, such as `time python script.py`.

instruction: How do I redirect stdout and stderr to the same log file?
output: Run `command > output.log 2>&1` to redirect both output streams into one file.

instruction: How do I locate the binary path of an installed command?
output: Run `which python3` to display the executable path for the specified command.

instruction: How do I count total lines in a CSV text file?
output: Run `wc -l dataset.csv` to count the total number of lines in the file.

instruction: How do I sort lines in a file and remove duplicates?
output: Run `sort file.txt | uniq` to sort lines and output unique entries.

instruction: How do I filter out lines containing the string 'DEBUG'?
output: Run `grep -v 'DEBUG' log.txt` to invert match and exclude matching lines.

instruction: How do I send a POST HTTP request with JSON payload using curl?
output: Run `curl -X POST https://api.example.com/data -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"a":1}'`.

instruction: How do I recursively change directory ownership to user 'ubuntu'?
output: Run `sudo chown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /path/to/dir` to recursively change owner.

instruction: How do I check Linux system uptime and load average?
output: Run `uptime` to view system running time, active users, and load averages.

instruction: How do I safely remove a file with confirmation prompt?
output: Run `rm -i filename` to remove the file with an interactive confirmation prompt.

instruction: How do I view differences between two text files line by line?
output: Run `diff file1.txt file2.txt` to compare line differences between two files.

instruction: How do I monitor NVIDIA GPU memory and utilization?
output: Run `nvidia-smi` to inspect NVIDIA GPU memory consumption and GPU load.

instruction: How do I create a directory hierarchy recursively in Linux?
output: Run `mkdir -p /path/to/nested/dir` to create parent directories as needed.

instruction: How do I search for text ignoring case in grep?
output: Run `grep -i 'pattern' file.txt` to perform a case-insensitive search.

instruction: How do I view first 20 lines of a text file?
output: Run `head -n 20 file.txt` to display the first 20 lines of the file.

instruction: How do I view last 20 lines of a text file?
output: Run `tail -n 20 file.txt` to display the last 20 lines of the file.

instruction: How do I change file permissions to read-only for all?
output: Run `chmod 444 file.txt` to set read-only permissions for owner, group, and others.

instruction: How do I display line numbers when viewing a file with cat?
output: Run `cat -n file.txt` to print file contents with line numbers.

instruction: How do I search for active processes owned by user 'ubuntu'?
output: Run `ps -u ubuntu` to list all active processes belonging to user ubuntu.

instruction: How do I check memory usage in megabytes in Linux?
output: Run `free -m` to view total and available memory in megabytes.

instruction: How do I print environment variable PATH in Bash?
output: Run `echo $PATH` to print current executable search path entries.

instruction: How do I alias a shell command in Bash?
output: Add `alias ll='ls -la'` to your `~/.bashrc` file to create a command alias.

instruction: How do I read and parse a JSON file in Python?
output: Use `json.load()` within a `with open('data.json') as f:` context block.

instruction: How do I write a Python dictionary to a formatted JSON file?
output: Use `json.dump(data, f, indent=2)` to serialize dictionary data to JSON.

instruction: How do I send an HTTP GET request in Python using requests?
output: Use `requests.get('https://example.com')` to fetch data from an HTTP endpoint.

instruction: How do I create a Python virtual environment in directory '.venv'?
output: Run `python3 -m venv .venv` to initialize a new Python virtual environment.

instruction: How do I install dependencies listed in requirements.txt?
output: Run `pip install -r requirements.txt` to install all listed packages.

instruction: How do I handle runtime exceptions gracefully in Python?
output: Wrap execution inside a `try:` block and catch errors using `except Exception as e:`.

instruction: How do I parse command line flags using argparse in Python?
output: Initialize `argparse.ArgumentParser()`, add args with `add_argument()`, and call `parse_args()`.

instruction: How do I measure precise execution time in Python?
output: Import `time` and compute elapsed time using `time.perf_counter()`.

instruction: How do I access operating system environment variables in Python?
output: Import `os` and retrieve variables using `os.getenv('VAR_NAME', 'default')`.

instruction: How do I define a data class in Python?
output: Decorate your class definition with `@dataclass` from the `dataclasses` module.

instruction: How do I check if a key exists in a Python dictionary?
output: Use the `in` operator, such as `if 'key' in my_dict:`.

instruction: How do I merge two dictionaries in Python 3.9+?
output: Use the union operator, such as `merged_dict = dict1 | dict2`.

instruction: How do I convert a list of strings into a single comma-separated string?
output: Use the string join method, such as `', '.join(string_list)`.

instruction: How do I remove leading and trailing whitespace from a Python string?
output: Call `.strip()` on the string instance, such as `cleaned_text = raw_text.strip()`.

instruction: How do I sort a list of dictionaries by a specific key in Python?
output: Use `sorted(data, key=lambda x: x['key_name'])` or `data.sort(key=...)`.

instruction: How do I create a shallow copy of a list in Python?
output: Use `.copy()` method or slice syntax, such as `new_list = old_list.copy()`.

instruction: How do I flatten a 2D list into a 1D list in Python?
output: Use a list comprehension, such as `[item for sublist in matrix for item in sublist]`.

instruction: How do I read lines of a text file into a list in Python?
output: Use `with open('file.txt') as f: lines = f.read().splitlines()`.

instruction: How do I check the length of a list or string in Python?
output: Pass the object to the built-in function `len()`, such as `len(my_list)`.

instruction: How do I convert a string representation of an integer to an int?
output: Pass the string to `int()`, such as `num = int('123')`.

instruction: How do I iterate over index and element simultaneously in Python?
output: Use `enumerate()`, such as `for idx, item in enumerate(my_list):`.

instruction: How do I define an asynchronous function in Python?
output: Prefix the function declaration with `async def my_func():`.

instruction: How do I run an async function in Python 3.7+?
output: Import `asyncio` and execute `asyncio.run(my_async_function())`.

instruction: How do I get unique elements from a list while preserving order in Python?
output: Use `list(dict.fromkeys(my_list))` to deduplicate elements while retaining order.

instruction: How do I check if all elements in a list satisfy a condition in Python?
output: Use the built-in `all()` function with a generator expression.

instruction: How do I check if at least one element satisfies a condition in Python?
output: Use the built-in `any()` function with a generator expression.

instruction: How do I filter elements in a list in Python?
output: Use list comprehension, such as `filtered = [x for x in data if x > 0]`.

instruction: How do I set a default value when getting a missing dictionary key?
output: Use `.get('key', default_value)` method on the dictionary instance.

instruction: How do I execute a shell command from Python and get output?
output: Import `subprocess` and run `subprocess.run(['ls', '-l'], capture_output=True, text=True)`.

instruction: How do I load environment variables from a .env file in Python?
output: Import `dotenv` and execute `dotenv.load_dotenv()` at startup.

instruction: How do I convert a string to lowercase in Python?
output: Call `.lower()` on the string, such as `text.lower()`.

instruction: How do I convert a string to uppercase in Python?
output: Call `.upper()` on the string, such as `text.upper()`.

instruction: How do I check if a string starts with a prefix in Python?
output: Call `.startswith('prefix')` on the string instance.

instruction: How do I check if a string ends with a suffix in Python?
output: Call `.endswith('suffix')` on the string instance.

instruction: How do I replace substrings in a Python string?
output: Call `.replace('old', 'new')` on the target string instance.

instruction: How do I convert a list of integers to a set in Python?
output: Pass the list to `set()`, such as `my_set = set(my_list)`.

instruction: How do I write a binary file in Python?
output: Open the file with `'wb'` mode, such as `with open('file.bin', 'wb') as f: f.write(data)`.

instruction: How do I read a binary file in Python?
output: Open the file with `'rb'` mode, such as `with open('file.bin', 'rb') as f: data = f.read()`.

instruction: How do I import a module dynamically in Python?
output: Import `importlib` and execute `importlib.import_module('module_name')`.

instruction: How do I format float numbers to 2 decimal places in Python?
output: Use f-string formatting, such as `f'{value:.2f}'`.

instruction: How do I list running Docker containers?
output: Run `docker ps` to display all currently active Docker containers.

instruction: How do I list all Docker containers including stopped ones?
output: Run `docker ps -a` to list all active and exited Docker containers.

instruction: How do I build a Docker image from a Dockerfile in current folder?
output: Run `docker build -t myapp:latest .` to compile the image.

instruction: How do I stop a running Docker container named 'web'?
output: Run `docker stop web` to send a graceful shutdown signal to the container.

instruction: How do I view logs from a Docker container named 'api'?
output: Run `docker logs -f api` to stream live output logs from the container.

instruction: How do I execute an interactive bash shell inside a running container?
output: Run `docker exec -it <container_id> /bin/bash` to enter the container.

instruction: How do I remove an unused Docker image?
output: Run `docker rmi <image_id>` or `docker image prune` to delete unused images.

instruction: How do I start services defined in a docker-compose.yml file?
output: Run `docker-compose up -d` to launch all defined services in background mode.

instruction: How do I stop services defined in docker-compose.yml?
output: Run `docker-compose down` to stop and remove containers, networks, and volumes.

instruction: How do I inspect details of a Docker container?
output: Run `docker inspect <container_id>` to view full JSON metadata of the container.

instruction: How do I select all columns from a table named 'users' in SQL?
output: Execute `SELECT * FROM users;` in your SQL database client.

instruction: How do I filter rows where age is greater than 18 in SQL?
output: Execute `SELECT * FROM users WHERE age > 18;` in SQL.

instruction: How do I count total records in a table named 'orders' in SQL?
output: Execute `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders;` to get total row count.

instruction: How do I update a user's email safely in SQL?
output: Execute `UPDATE users SET email = 'new@example.com' WHERE id = 1;`.

instruction: How do I query inactive users in SQL?
output: Execute `SELECT * FROM users WHERE status = 'inactive';` in your SQL client.

instruction: How do I sort SQL query results by creation date descending?
output: Append `ORDER BY created_at DESC` to your SQL SELECT query.

instruction: How do I limit SQL query results to 10 rows?
output: Append `LIMIT 10` to your SQL query statement.

instruction: How do I join two tables 'orders' and 'users' on user_id in SQL?
output: Use `SELECT * FROM orders JOIN users ON orders.user_id = users.id;`.

instruction: How do I create a primary key index on table 'products' in SQL?
output: Use `ALTER TABLE products ADD PRIMARY KEY (id);`.

instruction: How do I insert a new row into table 'users' in SQL?
output: Execute `INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES ('Alice', 'alice@example.com');`.

instruction: How do I send a JSON POST request in JavaScript fetch API?
output: Call `fetch(url, {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: data})`.

instruction: How do I parse a JSON string into an object in JavaScript?
output: Use `JSON.parse(json_string)` to deserialize JSON into a JavaScript object.

instruction: How do I convert a JavaScript object into a JSON string?
output: Use `JSON.stringify(object)` to serialize an object into a JSON string.

instruction: How do I declare an async function in JavaScript?
output: Use syntax `async function fetchData() { const res = await fetch(url); }`.

instruction: How do I handle rejected promises in JavaScript async/await?
output: Wrap your await call in a `try { ... } catch (error) { ... }` block.

instruction: How do I add an element to the end of an array in JavaScript?
output: Call `.push(element)` on the array instance, such as `arr.push('item')`.

instruction: How do I remove the last element of an array in JavaScript?
output: Call `.pop()` on the array instance, such as `const last = arr.pop()`.

instruction: How do I iterate over an array in JavaScript with element and index?
output: Use `array.forEach((item, index) => { ... })`.

instruction: How do I map array elements to a new array in JavaScript?
output: Use `array.map(x => x * 2)` to transform each element.

instruction: How do I filter array elements matching a condition in JavaScript?
output: Use `array.filter(x => x > 10)` to extract matching items.

instruction: How do I check container port mappings in Docker?
output: Run `docker port <container_id>` to view published container ports.

instruction: How do I restart a running Docker container?
output: Run `docker restart <container_id>` to restart the container.

instruction: How do I view Docker resource stats in real time?
output: Run `docker stats` to monitor CPU, memory, and network usage per container.

instruction: How do I pause execution of a running Docker container?
output: Run `docker pause <container_id>` to suspend container execution.

instruction: How do I unpause a suspended Docker container?
output: Run `docker unpause <container_id>` to resume execution of a paused container.

instruction: How do I create a new network in Docker?
output: Run `docker network create my_network` to create an isolated bridge network.

instruction: How do I list all Docker networks?
output: Run `docker network ls` to inspect all configured Docker networks.

instruction: How do I create a named Docker volume?
output: Run `docker volume create my_volume` to allocate a persistent storage volume.

instruction: How do I list all named Docker volumes?
output: Run `docker volume ls` to list existing persistent Docker volumes.

instruction: How do I select unique values of a column in SQL?
output: Execute `SELECT DISTINCT column_name FROM table_name;` in SQL.

instruction: How do I connect to a remote server using SSH on port 2222?
output: Run `ssh -p 2222 user@hostname` to connect via SSH on a custom port.

instruction: How do I copy a local file to a remote server using SCP?
output: Run `scp -P 2222 file.txt user@hostname:/remote/path/`.

instruction: How do I generate a 4096-bit RSA SSH key pair?
output: Run `ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C 'email@example.com'`.

instruction: How do I copy my public SSH key to a remote server for passwordless login?
output: Run `ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub user@hostname`.

instruction: How do I test DNS resolution for a domain name using dig?
output: Run `dig example.com +short` to perform a DNS lookup.

instruction: How do I trace network packet routing hops to a target server?
output: Run `traceroute example.com` or `mtr example.com` to trace network paths.

instruction: How do I check latency and packet loss to a host?
output: Run `ping -c 4 example.com` to send 4 ICMP echo requests.

instruction: How do I check systemd service status for nginx?
output: Run `systemctl status nginx` to inspect systemd unit status.

instruction: How do I restart a systemd service named 'postgresql'?
output: Run `sudo systemctl restart postgresql` to restart the service.

instruction: How do I enable a systemd service to start automatically on boot?
output: Run `sudo systemctl enable nginx` to enable auto-start at boot time.

instruction: How do I view systemd journal logs for unit 'docker'?
output: Run `journalctl -u docker -n 50 --no-pager` to view recent unit logs.

instruction: How do I check current firewall status in Ubuntu using ufw?
output: Run `sudo ufw status verbose` to view active firewall rules.

instruction: How do I allow incoming port 443 in ufw firewall?
output: Run `sudo ufw allow 443/tcp` to permit incoming HTTPS traffic.

instruction: How do I generate an MD5 checksum of a file in Linux?
output: Run `md5sum filename` to compute the MD5 hash digest.

instruction: How do I generate a SHA256 checksum of a file?
output: Run `sha256sum filename` to compute the SHA256 hash digest.

instruction: How do I check SSL certificate expiration date for a domain?
output: Run `openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 | openssl x509 -noout -dates`.

instruction: How do I create a self-signed SSL certificate using OpenSSL?
output: Run `openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -days 365 -nodes`.

instruction: How do I monitor disk I/O activity per process in Linux?
output: Run `sudo iotop` to monitor real-time disk read/write bandwidth by process.

instruction: How do I monitor network throughput per interface in Linux?
output: Run `iftop` or `nload` to monitor real-time network traffic per interface.

instruction: How do I find which process is using port 8080?
output: Run `lsof -i :8080` or `fuser 8080/tcp` to identify the owning process.

instruction: How do I send a term signal to the process using port 8080?
output: Run `fuser -k -15 8080/tcp` to send a graceful term signal to the process.

instruction: How do I check system kernel messages using dmesg?
output: Run `dmesg -T | tail -n 50` to print recent kernel ring buffer messages.

instruction: How do I reload Nginx configuration without dropping connections?
output: Run `sudo systemctl reload nginx` or `nginx -s reload`.

instruction: How do I test Nginx configuration syntax for errors?
output: Run `sudo nginx -t` to verify configuration syntax before reloading.

instruction: How do I list active crontab scheduled jobs for current user?
output: Run `crontab -l` to view all configured cron jobs for your user.

instruction: How do I edit active crontab scheduled jobs?
output: Run `crontab -e` to open the cron schedule configuration in your editor.

instruction: How do I schedule a script to run every day at midnight in cron?
output: Add line `0 0 * * * /path/to/script.sh` to your crontab file.

instruction: How do I schedule a script to run every 5 minutes in cron?
output: Add line `*/5 * * * * /path/to/script.sh` to your crontab file.

instruction: How do I set environment variable PATH permanently in Bash?
output: Add `export PATH="/new/path:$PATH"` to your `~/.bashrc` file.

instruction: How do I reload shell configuration after modifying .bashrc?
output: Run `source ~/.bashrc` to apply the updated environment configuration.

instruction: How do I create a zip archive of a directory in Linux?
output: Run `zip -r archive.zip folder_name/` to create a zip file.

instruction: How do I unzip a zip file named 'archive.zip'?
output: Run `unzip archive.zip` to extract files from the zip archive.

instruction: How do I download a web page source HTML using wget?
output: Run `wget -O page.html https://example.com` to download page source.

instruction: How do I sync files from local directory to remote server using rsync?
output: Run `rsync -avz /local/dir/ user@remote:/remote/dir/`.

instruction: How do I perform a dry run of an rsync sync command?
output: Run `rsync -avz --dry-run /local/dir/ user@remote:/remote/dir/`.

instruction: How do I check open file descriptor limits in Linux?
output: Run `ulimit -n` to view the maximum allowed open file descriptors per process.

instruction: How do I temporarily increase open file descriptor limit to 65536?
output: Run `ulimit -n 65536` in your current shell session.

instruction: How do I view CPU model and core information in Linux?
output: Run `lscpu` or `cat /proc/cpuinfo` to inspect CPU hardware details.

instruction: How do I check current system hostname in Linux?
output: Run `hostname` or `hostnamectl` to display the machine hostname.

instruction: How do I change machine hostname permanently in Ubuntu?
output: Run `sudo hostnamectl set-hostname new-hostname` to update machine name.
